fix_round.summary: Fixed G2-02, G2-03 (inquiries + follow_ups), G2-04 (dev1 part), SEC2-02 (0004 part), SEC2-03 (actions) and SEC2-04. 0004: inquiries insert/update policies require buyer_id / product_id / assigned_to of the caller's org, follow_ups require buyer_id of the caller's org; buyers UPDATE narrowed to editable columns (buyer_code, id, org_id, created_at locked). Buyer actions refuse Plant via canWriteBuyers (owner / accountant / sales, same as dev2's 0003 policy). Inquiry '+ New buyer' now follows screens.md 5 (name + phone on the inquiry, no buyer row); 'Save as buyer' starts Export with the country from the calling code and requires a country. ?next= on /buyers/new goes through safeInternalPath on the page and again in BuyerForm before router.push.
